name: Hollywood
dining_districts: downtown Hollywood around Hollywood Boulevard and Harrison Street
the Seminole Hard Rock corridor on State Road 7
intro: Hollywood feeds two very different crowds at once: the Broadwalk's two-and-a-half miles of oceanfront restaurants running high-volume, all-day service for beach traffic, and the downtown blocks around Harrison Street and Young Circle, where chef-driven rooms cook for locals year-round. West on State Road 7, the Seminole Hard Rock corridor adds casino-scale banquet and outlet volume that few suppliers handle gracefully.

We run Hollywood on the south Broward route out of Pompano Beach — about thirty minutes door to door — with Broadwalk stops timed before beach traffic locks up the barrier island. Beachfront kitchens run big standing orders for staples; downtown rooms use split cases to keep tighter menus interesting; and banquet kitchens step volume up and down against the events calendar.
route_note: About 30 minutes south of our Pompano Beach warehouse — Broadwalk stops are timed ahead of beach traffic, downtown and SR-7 follow on the same run.

faqs_unique.q: Do you deliver to Broadwalk restaurants on Hollywood Beach?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Broadwalk and beachfront kitchens receive early, before the beach fills in — drivers know the barrier island loading constraints and work your receiving window.

faqs_unique.q: Can you supply casino-corridor and banquet kitchens near the Hard Rock?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. High-volume banquet and outlet kitchens on the SR-7 corridor can run case-volume standing orders that flex with the events calendar.

cta_text: Tell us your weekly needs for Broadwalk dining, hotel service, neighborhood restaurants, or catering work. We will help match delivery timing and product mix to your Hollywood operation.
